prompt.summary: Recover the accepted ADC language across every public surface without replacing the product architecture.

evidence.notes: The accepted 2026-07-13 evidence is edition-first: one lead, three secondary stories, compact continuation, and Source Watch after the main edition. The homepage consumes bounded home.json data and omits internal quality scores. Acceptance covers the homepage, operations page, official-blog index, and generated report at the canonical 1280x900 desktop viewport only.

handoff.target_surface: apps/web plus generated public report and operations shells
handoff.translation_notes: Keep content engines separate, project report_date-owned editorial order into home.json, and converge only on a repository-owned ADC visual contract.
